#    segment (leading, trailing or embedded) and no such pattern at all, returns the value UNCHANGED
#    (this is why an already-normalized key round-trips as a no-op).
# 4. Otherwise (slow path): replaces every '\' with '/' (Windows separators).
# 5. Strips one leading './' if present.
# 6. Rejects '' or '.' after that strip (throws).
